questions.question: The area of a rectangular floor is 600 square feet. If the length of the floor is 30 feet, then what is the breadth of the floor?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of rectangular field: 600 square feet

Length of the floor: 30 feet

**Formula Used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Bredth

**Calculation:**

Let the breadth of the rectangular floor be 'b' feet.

⇒ 30 × b = 600

⇒ b = {600 over 30} = 20 

**The breadth of the rectangular floor is 20 cm.**

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the price of 6 different articles. The total price of all these 6 articles is Rs. 5760. The price of a particular article is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total price of all these 6 articles. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7541099aff21378116f72f6f7b5e2ac97918c01641afd463b0830ba0a724d3c.png] 

P1 = The difference between the average price of K and L and the average price of J and N.

P2 = The total price of J, M, N and O.

What is the value of (P1 + P2)?
questions.solution:
Given: 

The total price of all these 6 articles is 5760.

Concept Used:

All slices of the pie chart add up to make the whole equal 100 percent or 360 degrees.

Average = Sum of the prices of all articles/Number of articles.

**Calculation:**

The price of article K = 42°/360° × 5760 = 672

The price of article L = 116°/360° × 5760 = 1856

The average price of K and L = (672 + 1856)\2 = 1264

The price of article J = 100°/360° × 5760 = 1600

The price of article N = 15°/360° × 5760 = 240

The average price of J and N = (1600 + 240)/2 = 920

P1 = The difference between the average price of K and L and the average price of J and N

⇒ P1 = 1264 - 920 = 344

The price of article J = 100°/360° × 5760 = 1600

The price of article M = 33°/360° × 5760 = 528

The price of article N = 15°/360° × 5760 = 240

The price of article O = 54°/360° × 5760 = 864

P2 = The total price of J, M, N, and O 

P2 = 1600 + 528 + 240 + 864 = 3232

The value of P1 + P2 = 3576

**The value of P1 + P2 is 3576.**

questions.question: X and Y together can do a work in 10 days. Y and Z together can do the same work in 15 days. Z and X together can do the same work in 12 days. In how many days can Z alone do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

X and Y can complete a work in 10 days.

Y and Z can complete a work in 15 days.

Z and X can complete a work in 12 days.

**Formula used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation: **

X and Y can complete a work in 10 days.

Y and Z can complete a work in 15 days.

Z and X can complete a work in 12 days.

Let the total work be 60 units. (LCM of 10, 15, and 12).

Efficiency of X and Y = 60/10 = 6 units/day.....(1)

Efficiency of Y and Z = 60/15 = 4 units/day.....(2)

Efficiency of Z and X = 60/12 = 5 units/day.....(3)

From (1), (2) and (3), we get

]Efficiency of Z = 15/2 - 6 = 3/2 = 1.5 units/day 

Time taken by Z to complete the work 

= 60/1.5 

= 600/15 = 40 days

**Z can alone do the work for 40 days.**

questions.question: The average speed of a car is 1500 metres/minute. A sprinter covers 200 metres in 30 seconds. What is the difference in the speed of car and the speed of sprinter?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of car in m/s = 1500 ÷ 60 = 25 m/s

Speed of sprinter in m/s = 200 ÷ 30 = 20/3 m/s

Difference in speed = 25 − 20/3 = (75 − 20) ÷ 3 = 55/3 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car = 1500 metres/minute

Distance covered by sprinter = 200 metres

Time taken by sprinter = 30 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

1 minute = 60 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8d56f077e88100fe2ac528eaedd8eaa24b5b3745e5b87250a992497cabf3c8c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of car = 1500 metres ÷ 60 seconds

⇒ Speed of car = 25 m/s

⇒ Speed of sprinter = 200 metres ÷ 30 seconds

⇒ Speed of sprinter = 20/3 m/s

⇒ Difference in speed = Speed of car − Speed of sprinter

⇒ Difference = 25 − 20/3

⇒ Difference = (75 − 20) ÷ 3

⇒ Difference = 55/3 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

When traveling equal distances at varying speeds S₁ and S₂, the formula applied is: Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

questions.question: What is the smallest three-digit number which when divided by 2, 3 and 4 leaves remainder 1 in each case?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The smallest three-digit number leaves 1 remainder when divided by 2, 3, and 4.

**Concept used:**

The smallest three-digit number is 100.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 2, 3, and 4 is 12.

When we divide 100 by 12, we get 4 as the remainder.

The smallest three-digit number which is divisible by 2, 3, and 4

= 100 - 4 + 12

= 108

The smallest three-digit number which when divided by 2, 3, and 4 leaves 1 in each case = 108 + 1

= 109

**The required three-digit number is 109. **

questions.question: The HCF and LCM of the two numbers are 20 and 2880 respectively. If one of them is 180, then find the other number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

HCF and LCM of the two numbers are 20 and 2880.

One of the numbers is 180.

**Formula used:**

Product of numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

Let the other number be 'a'

⇒ 180 × a = 20 × 2880

⇒ a = 20 × 2880 / 180

⇒ a = 320

**The other number is 320.**

questions.question: In a 64 litres mixture, the alcohol and water are in the ratio of 1 ∶ 3 respectively. 32 liters of mixture is taken off and replaced with 16 liters of water. What is the new ratio of alcohol and water respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

64 liters of a mixture of alcohol and water are in the ratio 1∶ 3 respectively.

32 liters of mixture is removed and replaced with 16 liters of water.

**Calculation:**

Ratio of alcohol and water = 1:3

Let the quantity of water and alcohol in the mixture be a' and '3a'.

⇒ a + 3a = 64

⇒ 4a = 64

⇒ a = 16

The quantity of alcohol and water in the mixture is 16 liters and 48 liters.

As 32 liters of mixture is taken off this 32 liters also contain alcohol and water in the ratio of 1:3.

The quantity of alcohol taken off = 32/4 * 1= 8 liters

The quantity of water taken off = 32 - 8 = 24 liters

Now, adding 16 liters of water to the mixture

Quantity of alcohol in the final mixture = 16 - 8 = 8 liters

Quantity of water in the final mixture = 48 - 24 + 16 = 40 liters

The required ratio = 8∶ 40 = 1∶ 5.

**The new ratio of alcohol and water is respectively 1∶ 5.**

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 12960 in 2 years at the rate of 4 percent per annum on simple interest. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage for 2 years = 4% × 2 = 8%

Amount percentage = Principal (100%) + Interest (8%) = 108%

Given, 108% → Rs. 12960

100% → 12960 × (100 ÷ 108) = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = Rs. 12960

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 
 Principal

 Time = 2 years
 Rate = 4% p.a.
 + SI (8% of P)
 
 100%
 108% = Rs. 12960

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount = P + (P × 4 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 12960 = P + (8P ÷ 100)

⇒ 12960 = 108P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (12960 × 100) ÷ 108

⇒ P = 120 × 100

⇒ P = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest (CI)

When interest is compounded annually, Amount = P(1 + R/100)T.

Difference between CI and SI (2 years)

For a sum P at R% per annum for 2 years, Difference (D) = P × (R/100)².

Sum becoming n times

If a sum becomes 'n' times of itself at SI in 'T' years, Rate = (n − 1) × 100 ÷ T.

questions.question: If the price of onion increases from Rs. 60/kg to Rs. 75/kg, then by what percentage a household should decrease the consumption of onion so that expenditure remains same?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the household consume a kg of onion earlier and b kgs later.

The amount paid by the household earlier = Rs.60a

The amount paid by the household later = Rs.75b

Since both prices should be the same

⇒ 60a = 75b

⇒ 4a = 5b

⇒ b = 4a/5

Required percent = (a -b)/a × 100

= (a - 4a/5)/a × 100

= 100/5

= 20 

**The required percentage to decrease the consumption is 20 percent.**

questions.question: Sumit lent Rs. 5000 to Ram for 2 years and Rs. 8000 to Mayur for 3 years on simple interest at the same rate of interest and received Rs. 1700 in total from both of them as interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principle for Sumit = Rs.5000

Principle for Mayur = Rs.8000

Time for Sumit = 2 years

Time for Mayur = 3 years

Simple interest received from both = Rs.1700

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = P × R% × T

Where, P = Principle

R = Rate and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the rate of interest for both Sumit and Mayur be R.

In the case of Sumit,

Interest = 5000 × R× 2/100

= 100R

In the case of Mayur

Simple Interest = 8000× R× 3/100

= 240R 

According to the question, 

Simple interest received from both = Rs.1700

⇒ 100R + 240R = 1700

⇒ 340R = 1700

⇒ R = 5

**The rate of interest per annum is 5%.**

questions.question: The difference between the length and breadth of a rectangle is 40 metres. If its perimeter is 96 metres, then what will be the area of rectangle?
